objects.name: GitHub delays version updates so malware gets caught first
objects.description: An automated update tool watches a package registry, catches a new release the moment it publishes, and opens a pull request for your team. An attacker phished one npm maintainer’s credentials and shipped poisoned versions of chalk, debug, and about a dozen other packages. Together those packages are downloaded more than 2 billion times a week, and … More → The post GitHub delays version updates so malware gets caught first appeared first on Help Net Security .
